senses.en_definition: Possibly the personal name or surname Ellis; the referent and intended reading are unresolved without context.

senses.nuances: 这是候选专名释读，并非已核实的 DBP 普通词释义，故不标为 official。马来西亚文本确有 Ellis 专名，例如 UPM 的 Zon Ellis，涉及 Albert Ellis。以下搭配属于有出处的专名组合，未作频率认定。[UPM：Zon Ellis](https://bkupm.upm.edu.my/eksa/eksa_zone/ellis_zone-60551?L=bm)

etymology.historical_story: Names can enter Malay frequency lists through biographies, research citations and institutional labels. Ellis illustrates this possibility: Universiti Putra Malaysia uses Zon Ellis in connection with Albert Ellis. That attested name does not establish the identity of this lowercase token. Its personal-name history, pronunciation and source referent remain unresolved without the original passage.
